notes.title: Patch 0.8.7a
notes.notes:
Bug Fix

Fixed a bug that caused the menu to not load at the end of the game
rocket icon renewed
The error that caused the menu to be corrupted when pressing esc in the main menu has been fixed.
Fixed some bugs in unity's AI path
Fixed typos at the end of the game
Fixed a bug that caused sound glitches at the start of the game

notes.title: Patch notes
notes.notes:
Bug fixes:

Fixed a bug that caused the item collection panel to break on some screens.
Fixed a bug that caused the camera to sink into the ground.
Fixed the issue where spitters could not hit if you stopped at the end of the level part.
In the elevator at the end of the game, the enemies can no longer go inside to bury it in our mouths.
Fixed a bug that prevented the endgame cutscene from opening.
Fixed the lod of the door ahead of the black smoke men.
The bug that caused the zombies to teleport in front of us in the aftergarden section has been fixed.
Fixed the bug where the weapon still sells extra expensive parts by changing the sideparts and keeping the money fixed.
Fixed a bug that caused some objects to give empty messages.
Fixed a bug that caused a foliage zombie to drop critical points when assassinated
an unused key has been removed.
Fixed a bug that caused the camera to sometimes not rotate.
Fixed a bug that caused previously opened doors to give a message every time you enter the game
Fixed a bug that caused the hand adjustment of the pump shotgun to deteriorate after loading.
Fixed a bug where pool manager could not restore lost items.
Fixed a bug that caused close enemies to be aimed at their arms and torso.
Fixed the issue where the weapon would not be handled when constantly switching from rifle to shotgun.
Fixed the issue where the doors that were opened after loading could be re-opened.
The error that caused the doors to remain locked when loading has been fixed.
Fixed the issue where armors after level 3 had too little light.
The second blade was broken, it has been fixed.


Game Changes

Added message to lever in safe house.
Added save point and arsenals before smoke men.
Small buildings in the aftergarden were removed and containers were replaced.
A light has been added to the part that goes to the lower part so that it is clear from the aftergar that it is necessary to go to the lower part.
Extremely narrow spaces in the aftergarden building have been widened.
villa zombie with red eyes can now run.
Added damage to all weapon upgrades.
The gun mount has been retracted a little further into the ridge.
The width of the shotgun target has been reduced.
Added separate spreads for all weapons.
The size of the 3rd blade has been enlarged.

notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Game improvements

bullets have been added to the apartment.
A message indicating the status has been added to the levers in the 3 lamp locations.
Added a status message to the maze switch.
monsters' saliva can now be detonated by hitting them.
monsters' spit now has a trail effect.
Crafting now automatically switches to the next craftable item when unlocked.
When you make a purchase in your craft, it now automatically moves to the next level item.
Added critical locations that allow for extra damage that explodes when hitting a plant zombie.
Items are no longer placed in the first space they find, but in the most appropriate location they find.
The sand effect has been added to the sand materials.


Bug fix

the missing collider of the apartment has been added, it is now possible to go to the roof.
board effect is no longer output from the camera.
Added collider to objects without old collider.
it is no longer possible to climb into the corpse car and enter the bug.
]Side parts can no longer be changed in the craftable section.
The oversized medkit issue in the craftable section has been fixed.
If you close the menu while carrying items, it no longer gives an error.
Can no longer fly over the corpse.
Aim is no longer broken when the camera is against the wall.
The camera no longer slides into the wall when tapped and moved.
man going to eternity bug has been fixed.
Monsters' spit now properly deals damage.
The wood effect no longer comes out of monsters' spit.
Aim is no longer difficult in the open field.
The bug that caused the blade to disappear when you insert a knife as soon as you drop a bomb has been fixed.
The bug that prevents the character from animating when right click is left as it is and walking has been fixed.
The board effect no longer appears when fired on the ground.
The error that causes the objects to be interacted with sending empty text has been fixed.

notes.title: Going Deep Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes

no longer falling through the bridge
when we remove the fridge the door is no longer locked
Empty memroy slots can no longer be loaded.
Fixed a bug where zombies could not be hit due to a zombie falling into infinity.
Fixed a bug that caused enemies to fall to the ground with each hit.
Collider has been added to the objects passed through in the hospital area.
The upper floor door in villa 2 no longer opens backwards.
added collider to the cage on the roof.


Edits

Added a save location to the apartment.
The number of spitting zombies on the roof has been reduced.
Extra zombies have been added to some places.
The chance of falling while passing through the construction site has been removed.
The camera facing the fuse box has been zoomed out a bit.
Added return to save after labyrinth.

notes.title: Going Deep Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Bug fix:

Cutscenes no longer break when you repeatedly tap enter
Player commands such as pulling a knife cannot be used in cutscenes anymore.
Fixed an issue where the menu sometimes wouldn't open when restarting the game
Fixed a bug that disrupted collecting items when pressing the right mouse button.
Fixed an issue where the number of uncountable items was displayed when collecting items and dropping them into a slot that cannot be placed.
No longer need to press esc to close after reading the notes completely
Medkit is no longer doubled
Medkit now have description
Settings are now refreshed according to the settings of the user's screen
Settings save button now working properly
Pistol no longer automatic
Fixed a bug where the bomb sound was not heard
Fixed a bug that caused out-of-ammo weapons to make a continuous empty cartridge sound
Discard item UI is renewed
Message Panel UI renewed
